contracts.meaning: Planned quantity of one assembly-order component, in that component's own unit (FM assembly_order_item.qty_c): qty_per_batch x the AO's planned finished-good units, rounded up for fractional components (for example a component at 0.25 per batch on 1000 planned units gives 250). It is finished-good units only when qty_per_batch is 1; divide by qty_per_batch to read planned finished goods.
evidence: EVIDENCE/live/2026-09-30-ao-26005b-live-trace.json (live read of the Portal reporting API, 2026-09-30): packaging item 58383 of AO 10718 records quantity 1509.0, the AO's planned 1,509 (devloop/WORKING-BRIEF.md, verified state).

devloop/CONTEXT/03-PORTAL.md section 4.8 (Portal staging, read 2026-09-30): assembly_order_item.qty_c / actualamount surface as silver assembly_order_items.quantity / actual_amount; planned component qty.
contracts.verification: one live assembly-order transaction; the column's meaning on other assembly orders is not separately verified, and the role says nothing about the value being present, current or correct.

contracts.meaning: Derived component consumption, not a count: FM actualamount = qty_per_batch x the AO's total produced finished-good units including samples (totalprodqty_c, not served by the reporting API), cascaded by the Portal (lib/inventory/assembly-lifecycle.ts:cascadeAssemblyActualQty). Every line equals the produced finished-good units x its BOM ratio (for example 1000 produced units x 0.25 gives 250). Divide by qty_per_batch to read produced finished goods. Not the same quantity as planned.
evidence: EVIDENCE/live/2026-09-30-ao-26005b-live-trace.json (live read of the Portal reporting API, 2026-09-30): items 58382-58387 of AO 10718 record actual_amount 5974.425 / 1503.0 / 1503.0 / 1503.0 / 375.75 / 751.5 against qty_per_batch 3.975 / 1 / 1 / 1 / 0.25 / 0.5, i.e. 1503 x qty_per_batch on every line (devloop/CONTEXT/02-CASES-AND-ARTIFACTS.md section 3.4: derived, not counted).

devloop/CONTEXT/03-PORTAL.md section 4.8 (Portal staging, read 2026-09-30): actualamount = qty_per_batch x totalprodqty_c (lib/inventory/assembly-lifecycle.ts:cascadeAssemblyActualQty:198); totalprodqty_c includes samples.
contracts.verification: one live assembly-order transaction; the column's meaning on other assembly orders is not separately verified, and the role says nothing about the value being present, current or correct.
